observations.title: Camera response to motion
observations.player_action: Strafe, turn, jump, fall, move forward/backward, or wait motionless.
observations.outcome: Camera roll, pitch and idle sway provide movement feedback; nearby explosions can shake the view.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Adjust or disable an individual camera effect
observations.player_action: Use the configuration screen or cameraoverhaul.toml and set the relevant intensity factor.
observations.outcome: A factor of 0.0 disables that effect; supported negative factors invert it.
conditions: These are client presentation settings; they are not player movement or combat authority.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
